aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds practical software for food trucks and mobile hospitality: online orders, collection times and fewer repetitive questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile hospitality, helping them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing smoothly and spend less time dealing with repetitive questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet much of the software available to them is designed around businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our focus is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around how these businesses actually operate.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started with a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a directory helping people discover food trucks visiting their local area, I spent more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are constantly moving, working at different locations and serving customers in changing conditions.

featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers pre-order for a future date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.advanced_reporting: Break sales down by period, item and event and see what really sells.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — you do not need to confirm each one separately.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Give an order a buzzer number when you hand it out, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers can see, with order numbers and a notice when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck is shown on the public HatchGrab map so nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show upcoming dates on your own website. Each one leads directly to its ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to work with HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen and the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. Once a time slot is full, customers cannot choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital stamp cards — stamps are collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into meal deals and offer extras at checkout to increase the average order value.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: The same as WhatsApp auto-replies, for questions on Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — at the counter and in the kitchen — all showing the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own logins with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you lose signal, online ordering stops so customers cannot place orders you would not see. With the iPhone, iPad and Android app you take orders offline too; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: When customers order online, they pay by card up front, via the Stripe service.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a deadline for items that must be ordered in advance.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that are not shown on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website or from a photo you already post on Facebook. You just review and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically send customers an SMS when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — for each week and event we automatically add your dates, locations and times.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item as sold out with one tap — customers immediately see it greyed out.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock level that goes down with each order, then the item is automatically marked as sold out.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments with a supported phone, so you do not need a separate card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets to a Bluetooth printer or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a time slot for their collection time, which spreads demand across your whole trading period.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage walk-up orders, paid on your card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your trading in the browser on any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Automatic replies to questions about your menu and schedule on WhatsApp.

landing.does.devicesBody: On the phone in your apron, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the food truck — and on the card terminal you already take payments with.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, reliable wifi and the same opening hours every week. But you are somewhere else every week, at different times, with weak mobile signal or none. HatchGrab is made exactly for that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If you lose signal, online ordering stops automatically so customers cannot place orders you would not see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in your dates, locations and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your posts on Facebook and Instagram
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Shorter queues, and food that is ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Made for food trucks, not restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” WhatsApp messages get answered for you while you are driving to your trading spot or standing at the grill — with your menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
